name: Nuggets New Songs
summary:
Nuggets New Songs was a browser game by Рекомендуемое hosted on Yandex. In the game you had to unlock music tracks in relation to the Gegagedigedagedago meme, most of which being mashups and arrangements of Cotton Eye Joe.

As of 2025, the game is currently inaccessible due to it being removed from Yandex. No known archives of the game are known to exist, though partial parts of the game soundtrack remain online.
